programName: Engineering Science - Electrical & Computer Engineering (ECE) Major (Bachelor of Applied Science, BASc) Faculty of Applied Science & Engineering
programDescription: The ECE program prepares students with a broad foundation and training in both hardware and software. Focus areas include photonics and semiconductor physics, computer hardware, electronics, and software. Core courses cover electromagnetic fields, energy systems, electronics, computer organization, systems software, and computing. The program offers a very broad range of technical electives, allowing students to focus on their specific interests within ECE.
